english.title: Supply false / misleading information about transplant operations - Human Tissue Act 2004
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in purported compliance with regulations under section 34 of the Human Tissue Act 2004, knowingly or recklessly supplied information which was false or misleading in a material respect, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INFORMATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34(3)(b) and (5) of the Human Tissue Act 2004.

english.notes: Section 34(6) of the Human Tissue Act 2004 provides that transplantable material has the same meaning as in section 33 of the Act.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, in purported compliance with regulations under section 34 of the Human Tissue Act 2004, knowingly or recklessly supplied information which was false or misleading in a material respect, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INFORMATION..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
